AAB: Countervailing duty paid in cash prior to a formal finding of subsidization by Customs.
AAC: Countervailing duty paid by posting a bond during an investigation period prior to a formal decision on subsidization by Customs.
SWT: Wage tax share of the invoice amount to be paid directly to the tax collector(s office).
AAE: General fee or tax for the use of energy.
AAF: A tax levied specifically on coffee products.
AAG: A harmonized sales tax consisting of a goods and service tax, a Canadian provincial sales tax and, as applicable, a Quebec sales tax which is recoverable.
AAH: A sales tax charged within the Canadian province of Quebec which is recoverable.
AAI: A sales tax charged within Canadian provinces which is non-recoverable.
AAJ: A tax levied on a replacement part, where the original part is returned.
AAK: Tax that is levied specifically on products containing mineral oil.
AAL: To indicate a special type of tax.
AAM: A tax levied specifically on insurances.
AAD: A tax levied on tobacco products.
TAC: A tax levied based on the type of alcohol being obtained.
ADD: Duty applied to goods ruled to have been dumped in an import market at a price lower than that in the exporter's domestic market.
SUP: Duty suspended or deferred from payment.
SUR: A tax or duty applied on and in addition to existing duties and taxes.
GST: Tax levied on the final consumption of goods and services throughout the production and distribution chain.
LAC: Government assessed charge for permit to do business.
BOL: Tax required in Italy, which may be fixed or graduated in various circumstances (e.g. VAT exempt documents or bank receipts).
SSS: Social securities share of the invoice amount to be paid directly to the social securities collector.
PRF: Duties laid down in the Customs tariff, to which goods are liable on entering or leaving the Customs territory falling under a preferential regime such as Generalised System of Preferences (GSP).
EXC: Customs or fiscal authorities code to identify a specific or ad valorem levy on a specific commodity, applied either domestically or at time of importation.
LST: Tax imposed for clean-up of leaky underground storage tanks.
EXP: Monetary rebate given to the seller in certain circumstances when agricultural products are exported.
LDP: Fee levied on a vessel to pay for port navigation lights.
TTA: Tax levied based on the vessel's net tonnage.
CUD: Duties laid down in the Customs tariff, to which goods are liable on entering or leaving the Customs territory (CCC).
ENV: Tax assessed for funding or assuring environmental protection or clean-up.
TOT: The summary amount of all taxes.
TOX: Tax levied on the total sales/turnover of a corporation.
MCA: Levy on Common Agricultural Policy (European Union) goods used to compensate for fluctuating currencies between member states.
CAP: Levy imposed on agricultural products where there is a difference between the selling price between trading countries.
CAR: A tax that is levied on the value of the automobile.
VAD: Duty paid and held on deposit, by Customs, during an investigation period prior to a formal decision on valuation of the goods being made.
STT: All applicable sale taxes by authorities at the state or provincial level, below national level.
LOC: Assessment charges on sale of goods or services by city, borough country or other taxing authorities below state or provincial level.
CST: Tax related to a specified commodity, e.g. illuminants, salts.
VAT: A tax on domestic or imported goods applied to the value added at each stage in the production/distribution cycle.
FET: Tax levied by the federal government on the manufacture of specific items.
PDB: Anti-dumping duty paid by posting a bond during an investigation period prior to a formal decision on dumping by Customs.
PDC: Anti-dumping duty paid in cash prior to a formal finding of dumping by Customs.
IND: A tax levied based on an individual's ability to pay.
MCD: Duty paid and held on deposit, by Customs, during an investigation period prior to a final decision being made on any aspect related to imported goods (except valuation) by Customs.
CVD: A duty on imported goods applied for compensate for subsidies granted to those goods in the exporting country.
AAA: A tax levied on the volume of petroleum being transacted.
